senses.gloss: ind. By what? whence, how, why; वत्सोपमन्यो केन वृत्तिं कल्पयसि [[Mb. 1. 3. 36.]] केनेशितोपनिषद्, केनोपनिषद् N. of one of the old principal Upaniṣads.

__1 The head. 
__2 The skull. 
__3 A cheek. 
__4 A joint. 
__5 The temples. 
__6 A kind of hell.
a. Ved. Wise, learned (मेधाविन्); यथा केनिपानामिनो वृधे [[Rv. 10. 44. 4.]]
A rudder, helm, a large oar used as a rudder.

केन्दुः,
 
-न्दुकः N. of a tree (Mangosteen), a variety of ebony.

__1 The centre of a circle. 
__2 The argument of a circle. 
__3 The argument of an equation. 
__4 Distance of a planet from the first point of its orbit in the 4th, 7th or 10th degree. 
__5 The first, fourth, seventh and tenth lunar mansion.
